"''Bail Antilles of Alderaan and Ainlee Teem of Malastare.|[[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Amidala]] of Naboo and her chief of security, [[Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka]]|}} '''Ainlee Teem''' was a [[Gran]] [[senator]] who [[Malastare delegation|represented]] the [[planet]] of [[Malastare]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] during the last [[Standard decade|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo|invaded]] the planet [[Naboo]], the then-[[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] was voted out of his [[Office of the Chancellor|office]]. Along with [[Bail Antilles]] of [[Alderaan]] and [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] of Naboo, Teem was nominated as Valorum's potential successor. However, Teem's reputation was tainted with suspicions of corruption, and his candidacy was met with general disdain.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Crisis on Naboo}} Ultimately, it was Palpatine who won the election. Teem continued to serve the Senate during the [[Clone Wars]]. ==Behind the scenes== Ainlee Teem was first mentioned in the [[1999]] film {{Film|I}} and later made his first appearance in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Senate Murders]]," later returning in the episode "[[Crisis at the Heart]]."{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} However, Teem was not identified by name in either episode; instead, the Gran was only confirmed to be Teem in the [[Guide to the Galaxy]] section of [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 64|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 64]].{{BuildFalconCite|64|Guide to the Galaxy}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|I}} {{1stm}} *''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' {{Ab|Queen's Shadow (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *{{TCW|Senate Murders}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Ainlee Teem}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *{{BuildFalconCite|64|Guide to the Galaxy}} {{1stID|Ainlee Teem}} *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Crisis on Naboo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Ainlee Teem#kanon |es=Ainlee Teem |fr=Ainlee Teem |hu=Ainlee Teem |ja=エインリー・ティーム |nl=Ainlee Teem |pl=Ainlee Teem }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Teem, Ainlee}} [[Category:Galactic Republic senators]] [[Category:Gran]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
